messages:
nisha: FYI — noticed the GPU reservation queue has grown ~3x overnight and we also have a cloud billing spike tied to pending reserved commitments. need quick triage, cc @omar @jess :eyes:
omar: Can you paste the top offenders? region / size / requester?
jess: top 3 are: customer-training (us-west2, 16xA100, requested 6w), ml-infra-loadtest (us-east1, 8xA5000, 2w), and research-batch (europe-west1, 4xA100, 1mo). billing anomaly shows many short-term 1mo commits converting to on-demand because of capacity mismatch.
infra-bot: snapshot: queue_length=27, pending_gpus=128, avg_lead_time=13 days, recent_failures=4
kevin: short-term commits are killing unit cost. if lots of 1mo requests are getting forced on-demand we pay a premium. propose we: 1) enforce minimum 3mo for reserved SKU, 2) add a fast-track for infra-critical requests, 3) open a small preemptible pool for burst.
lia: we have an upcoming enterprise onboarding (AcmeHealth) that explicitly needs guaranteed capacity next month. can we mark as P0 and shift from the queue?
omar: yes, we can bump AcmeHealth to P0 — I’ll move 16 GPUs from the dev-reserve pool. but that will push devs back ~2w.
jess: finance-bot shows cost delta if we convert 32 GPUs to reserved 6mo: est_savings=22% vs on-demand, but commit = $170k. need approval from finance. @finance-bot can we get the detailed amortization for next 12 months?
finance-bot: attached amortization CSV link (s3://redwood-billing/ir/1767123456-amort.csv) — short summary: break-even 7.1 months at current utilization, peak-safety buffer recommended +10% capacity.
kevin: thanks. Another idea: proactively offer teams a 3mo discount plan for burst use so we avoid many 1mo flips. small UX change in console + CLI flag `--short-reserve=3mo` could reduce churn.
nisha: good. immediate action items: 1) @omar escalate AcmeHealth to P0 and document impact, 2) @jess open a finance ticket with amortization and ask for provisional sign-off for 32 GPUs 6mo, 3) @kevin prototype preemptible burst pool (4x A100 equiv) for next 48h, 4) ops: start enforcing min 3mo for reserved API by Friday (soft warning first).
omar: on it. moving AcmeHealth now.
jess: finance ticket filed: FT-4982. tagging legal for the provisional contract change.
kevin: I'll spin up the preemptible pool and post metrics.
lia: ping me once AcmeHealth is moved so I can confirm their tests.
nisha: thanks team. if we see another spike overnight we may have to open emergency RFQ with cloud vendor — keeping this thread for updates. :alarm_clock:
